scope.summary: Enforce that any command invoked by a non-operator caller (plugin, external REST client, model lane) that mutates document authority routes through the kernel sandbox -> StudioValidationDescriptor -> PromotionGate lifecycle and NEVER writes authority rows directly; dry-run and read-only commands are exempt. Operator UI commands follow the same promotion-equivalence lifecycle. A mutation attempted outside the gate is rejected, never applied optimistically.
acceptance_criteria: all non-operator mutating commands gated; direct authority write rejected; dry-run/read exempt
expected_tests: negative: plugin/REST/model mutation attempting direct authority write is rejected (fails closed)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / Promotion lifecycle for scripted callers (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Scripted callers bypass validation/promotion; authority corruption.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
